title: PTY / sandbox dependency boundary
description: isolation.md invariant: the PTY layer must not know about Bubblewrap. The PTY runner source MUST NOT reference the Bubblewrap backend or bwrap mechanics; it accepts only a prepared process. Discharged by the pty-sandbox-boundary checker in verification support, which scans the PTY runner source. Attested by the @contract scenario in features/pty-sandbox-boundary.feature.
rationale: New sandbox backends must never change the PTY architecture. The PTY runner takes a PreparedProcess and launches it verbatim.
